title: AI Agency Pricing Australia | How We Charge | Crenosoft
desc: How Crenosoft prices AI projects in Australia: free audit, fixed-price builds, monthly AI Employee fees and dedicated teams. Clear quotes in AUD.
h1: Clear, Fixed Pricing for AI Projects
lead: No hourly surprises. Every Crenosoft project starts with a free audit, then a fixed quote in AUD before any work begins.
hero_cta: Book a Free AI AuditHow AI Employees work
body:
How our pricing works

StageWhat it isHow it is priced
Free AI auditA 30-minute call to find your best AI opportunitiesFree, no obligation
BlueprintA written plan: what the AI does, systems, data protection and timelineIncluded with every quote
BuildDesigning, connecting and testing your AI systemFixed price in AUD, agreed upfront
Run and improveHosting, monitoring, AI usage, human review and monthly improvementsFixed monthly fee in AUD
ConsultingStrategy, readiness assessments and trainingFixed price per engagement
Dedicated AI teamEngineers working only on your productMonthly, based on team size

What affects the price

  • Number of systems the AI connects to, such as your CRM, calendar, phone system or accounting software
  • Volume of calls, messages, documents or records it handles each month
  • Complexity of the rules, decisions and exceptions involved
  • Level of human review needed, especially for AI Employees with 24/7 coverage
  • Testing and compliance requirements in regulated industries

What’s included in every project

  • A written blueprint and fixed quote before work starts
  • Testing on real examples from your business
  • Documentation of what the system does and what data it uses
  • Training for your team
  • Privacy design aligned with the Privacy Act 1988
  • A monthly report on hours saved, issues fixed and improvements

The hours-saved guarantee

For our AI Employees service, we agree an hours-saved target in writing. If it isn’t met within 90 days of going live, we keep working on it at no extra cost until it is. Full terms are in your agreement.

Is AI worth it for your business?

Use our automation savings calculator to estimate what repetitive work costs you each year, then book a free audit to see what AI could realistically take off your team.
faqs: How much does an AI agent cost in Australia?
It depends on the systems it connects to, the volume of work and the level of human review. We quote a fixed build price and a fixed monthly fee in AUD after a free 30-minute audit.
Do you charge by the hour?
No. Builds and consulting are fixed price, and ongoing services are a fixed monthly fee, so you know the cost before you commit.
Are prices in AUD and do they include GST?
All quotes are in Australian dollars and show GST separately where it applies.
Minimum terms for ongoing services are set out clearly in your proposal before you sign, so there are no surprises.
